title: StructuredQuestionV1
description: The structured-question PERSISTED format (plan §3.6): the superset schema a stored/resumed question set may satisfy, which is why the text variant still allows `allowBlank`/`maxLength` — those are migration-only fields preserved so a historical record's `questionSetSha256` still round-trips (src/types/structuredQuestionV1.ts, decodeStructuredQuestionsV1). A question set is a JSON array of 1-16 question objects. Unknown properties are rejected. FRESH provider/model envelopes are additionally constrained by decodeStructuredQuestionsFromProviderV1, which rejects `allowBlank`/`maxLength` on a text question outright (owner decision, 2026-08-16: those are app-owned, not model-authored) — a strictly narrower rule than this schema expresses, mechanically checked against the fixture corpus by scripts/verifyStructuredQuestions.mjs (verify:structured-questions) rather than encoded as a second schema file. Constraints draft-07 cannot express — unique questionId values across the set, unique optionId values within a question, multipleChoice selection bounds within the actual option count, and the 256 KiB canonical-byte limit — are enforced by the runtime decoder and mechanically checked, together with this schema, by the same verifier.
